focus: Angle 1 — routing artifact parity, system-deep-loop hub

findingDetails.title: Seven hub routing artifacts carry six disagreeing version values, two with no version key
findingDetails.evidence: SKILL.md=3.0.0.0, mode-registry.json=2.0.0.1, hub-router.json=2.0.1.1, ROUTER.md=1.0.1.0, description.json=2.2.3.0, leaf-manifest.json has no version key, graph-metadata.json has no version key. Both sibling hubs keep SKILL.md and description.json in exact parity; sk-code additionally keeps mode-registry.json == hub-router.json.
findingDetails.impact: A reader or drift gate cannot tell whether these artifacts are the same generation.
findingDetails.recommendation: Establish one generation field shared across the hub-root artifacts, or document that they version independently and correct SKILL.md/description.json parity. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read all seven hub-root artifacts directly plus the same five artifacts in sk-code and cli-external-orchestration as a fleet control.

findingDetails.title: SKILL.md states two improvement-lane counts and a six-mode roster no artifact supports
findingDetails.evidence: SKILL.md:27 and :58 say two lanes; SKILL.md:161 says three lanes; SKILL.md:131 says six registered modes. mode-registry.json holds five modes with no skill-improvement entry, loop-host.cjs:40 validates a two-mode set, README.md:62 says three lanes, mode-registry.json:16 says two, description.json:3 says five modes.
findingDetails.impact: A reader told to extend the six registered modes is pointed at a roster that does not exist, and the lane count is self-contradictory inside one document.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reconcile the two lane counts and the registered-mode count against mode-registry.json. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Counted modes independently in registry, hub-router routerSignals, leaf-manifest mode entries and description.json prose; grepped the improvement packet for a third lane.

findingDetails.title: hub-router.json and ROUTER.md state opposite always-loaded-preamble policies
findingDetails.evidence: hub-router.json:13 sets defaultResource to a two-element array [ROUTER.md, mode-registry.json]. ROUTER.md:67-69 states no always-loaded preamble exists and sets DEFAULT_RESOURCE = []. The compiled-routing authored validator requires a scalar string for a non-null defaultResource; this hub's own registry-compiler branch never reads the field, so no live route fails today.
findingDetails.impact: An operator reading the two artifacts learns two different no-match behaviours; the array shape is outside the authored contract on any hub whose compiler does read the field.
findingDetails.recommendation: Decide the hub's no-match policy once and make both artifacts state it in a shape the compiler accepts. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Read both artifacts at their exact lines, read the compiler validator that constrains the field, and grepped the hub's compiler branch for the field.

findingDetails.title: Identical 61-leaf sets for both improvement lanes against a two-leaf ROUTER.md scope
findingDetails.evidence: Both lane entries carry 61 leaves and the arrays compare byte-equal (JSON.stringify equality true), mixing 15 agent-improvement files into the benchmark lane and 39 benchmark files into the agent lane. generate-leaf-manifest.cjs:161-163 promises distinct independently addressable leaf sets for exactly this N-to-1 fan-out. ROUTER.md:100-103 scopes MODEL_BENCHMARK to two leaves, and SKILL.md:120 requires the two artifacts to stay in sync.
findingDetails.impact: The lanes are not independently addressable, and the manifest disagrees with ROUTER.md by a factor of thirty on the artifact pair a hub rule requires to agree.
findingDetails.recommendation: Scope each lane's manifest entry to its own packet sub-tree and reconcile ROUTER.md with it. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Compared the two lane arrays programmatically for byte equality and counted lane-specific members in each; read the generator contract and the hub sync rule.

findingDetails.title: Retired families still present in hub keyword block and graph-metadata discovery terms
findingDetails.evidence: SKILL.md:8 lists conformance, standard-authority, conformance-review, read-only-default, context-gathering and reuse-catalog; graph-metadata.json:124 carries standard-authority in derived.key_topics and :113 carries skill benchmark in derived.trigger_phrases. No registry mode or alias names any of them.
findingDetails.impact: Derived discovery terms can still surface the hub for a request naming a family the hub no longer routes.
findingDetails.recommendation: Regenerate both surfaces from the live roster. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Tested each residue term against every registry workflowMode and alias; grepped the improvement packet for a reintroducing registry.

findingDetails.title: Two model-benchmark registry aliases are absent from the hub scoring vocabulary
findingDetails.evidence: mode-registry.json:147 declares prompt framework benchmark and benchmark-harness as model-benchmark aliases; hub-router.json:58-60 scopes the model-benchmark-aliases class to /deep:model-benchmark, model benchmark and benchmark a model. Neither registry term appears in any class, and SKILL.md:8 carries benchmark-harness as a hub keyword.
findingDetails.impact: A request phrased with those terms scores no mode and reaches the hub defer outcome.
findingDetails.recommendation: Align the scoring vocabulary with the registry aliases, or remove the aliases. No fix was made during this review.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Computed registry-only and hub-only term sets per mode by set difference rather than sampling, then checked adjacent classes for the missing terms.

results.summary: Angle 1 names seven artifacts and five properties; all seven and all five were covered, but four properties disagree and the spec names no resolution authority.
The phase spec carries no per-iteration checklist rows; its REQ rows are assessed at synthesis.

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Seven mutually-constraining routing artifacts over five registered modes with two tiers of routing, a compiled router, and a generator-produced leaf manifest.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Angle 1 names exactly these seven artifacts as the parity set, and they are the only artifacts that jointly define hub mode identity.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The seven hub artifacts describe one coherent generation and therefore carry a reconcilable version set.

searchActions.queryOrPath: every hub-root artifact version field via file read and node JSON parse
searchActions.result: Six distinct version values and two artifacts with no version key; siblings keep SKILL.md and description.json in exact parity.

searchLedger.rationale: The parity sibling hubs maintain on two pairs is broken here, so this is a hub-local defect rather than a fleet convention.

searchLedger.invariant: Any roster count stated in hub prose equals the number of registry modes.

searchActions.queryOrPath: registry workflowMode list against SKILL.md:27/:58/:131/:161 claim lines
searchActions.result: Five modes everywhere in machine artifacts; SKILL.md states both two and three improvement lanes and a six-mode roster.

searchLedger.rationale: Five independent artifacts agree on five modes; the one document that disagrees with itself is the hub SKILL.md.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The zero-match policy is stated once and identically in both routing artifacts.

searchActions.queryOrPath: hub-router routerPolicy.defaultResource to ROUTER.md DEFAULT_RESOURCE to the compiled-routing authored validator
searchActions.result: hub-router declares a two-file array preamble; ROUTER.md declares an empty preamble and says none exists; the validator accepts only a scalar string.

searchLedger.rationale: Two artifacts state opposite policies and the declared shape is outside the authored contract for that field.

searchLedger.invariant: Two workflow modes sharing one packet still carry distinct, independently addressable leaf sets.

searchActions.queryOrPath: agent-improvement leaves vs model-benchmark leaves vs ROUTER.md MODEL_BENCHMARK scope
searchActions.result: Byte-identical 61-leaf arrays; ROUTER.md scopes the benchmark lane to two leaves.

searchLedger.rationale: The generator's stated contract for this fan-out case is distinct sets, and the hub's own sync rule is broken by 2-vs-61.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Hub discovery surfaces name only families the registry still routes.

searchActions.queryOrPath: retired family terms against every registry mode and alias
searchActions.result: Six terms in the SKILL.md keyword block and two derived terms in graph-metadata match nothing in the registry.

searchLedger.rationale: Residue is real; consequence is bounded to discovery text rather than a control path.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Every registry alias is visible to the hub's scoring vocabulary.

searchActions.queryOrPath: per-mode registry aliases minus hub-router vocabularyClasses keywords
searchActions.result: model-benchmark registry-only: prompt framework benchmark, benchmark-harness.

searchLedger.rationale: Registry and scoring vocabulary disagree, so those phrasings score no mode.

searchLedger.invariant: A hub's allowed-tools grant equals the exact union of every registered mode's toolSurface.allowed.

searchActions.queryOrPath: union of mode toolSurface.allowed against SKILL.md frontmatter grant
searchActions.result: Union and grant are both Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob, Task, WebFetch; equal.

searchLedger.rationale: The sets are identical, so the hub invariant holds.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Exact set equality confirmed by comparison of the union against the declared grant.

searchLedger.invariant: Every RESOURCE_MAP path resolves on disk and is registered in leaf-manifest.json.

searchActions.queryOrPath: all 14 RESOURCE_MAP paths against disk and manifest
searchActions.result: 14/14 exist on disk and 14/14 registered under their own workflow mode.

searchLedger.rationale: No missing or unregistered leaf path exists in the routed set.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Per-path existence and per-mode registration both confirmed for the full set.

searchLedger.invariant: Hub-identity keywords appear in no mode scoring class, so a bare hub name defers.

searchActions.queryOrPath: hub-identity keywords against every other vocabulary class
searchActions.result: No overlap; discoveryClassesContract holds as written.

searchLedger.rationale: The defer guard behaves as documented.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Empty intersection between hub-identity and every mode class.
